goal: gRPC review: service authorisation, deadlines, message size limits and error status.
use: gRPC review: service authorisation, deadlines, message size limits and error status. Use when a gRPC service or client is added or changed.

steps.note: List the services and methods, with their callers.
Check authorisation. Each method needs a policy check.
Check deadlines. Clients must set a deadline on every call.
Check limits. Flag missing message size limits.
Report. Each method with file and line, severity and the fix.
